Contents.Html:
[page[title]]

Give applications one governed way to select and run inference providers without coupling business workflows to a vendor.

All platform domainsView the GitHub repositoryRead the documentation

What it owns

  • Named providers for Ollama, OpenAI, Foundry and Codex.
  • Completion, agent orchestration and model-capability services.
  • Per-provider concurrency limits, transient retry handling and capability-driven model discovery.

Why the boundary matters

Applications can choose the right inference boundary for a workload while retaining explicit provider configuration, operational limits and deterministic business control around probabilistic output.

How it fits

AI is a key adjacent domain and is already consumed by the CRM application. It is not yet included in cCoder.Core, but is expected to join the composition when its independent provider abstraction and reuse boundary are ready for wider platform use.

Getting started

The source, current README, sample hosts and tests live in cCoder.AI on GitHub. The repository README is the version-specific starting point; the outline below explains how the pieces fit together.

Reference the package

<PackageReference Include="cCoder.AI" Version="YOUR_VERSION" />

During coordinated local development the repositories may substitute a sibling ProjectReference. Published applications should normally consume the agreed package version so the dependency boundary remains explicit.

Register it in the host

builder.Services.AddAI(ai =>
{
    ai.DefaultProvider = "local";
    ai.AddOllama("local", p =>
    {
        p.Endpoint = "http://localhost:11434";
        p.Model = "qwen3.5:4b";
        p.MaxConcurrency = 1;
    });
});

Configure and run it

Register each Ollama, OpenAI, Foundry or Codex endpoint once under a stable provider key. Store API keys outside source control, set provider concurrency deliberately, and configure retry behaviour for transient 408, 429 and 5xx responses.

Consume the capability

Inject ICompletionProviderService for completion requests or IAgentOrchestrationService for agent runs, passing the provider key when the default is not appropriate. Query IModelManagerService before offering model selection.

Build and verify from source

git clone https://github.com/ccoder-co-uk/cCoder.AI.git
cd cCoder.AI
dotnet build
dotnet test

Use the repository-specific solution and test commands from its README when working on the domain itself; the standalone and acceptance-test hosts show the supported application boundary more accurately than an isolated snippet can.
